Proposition
[Ricci-tensor evolution] 1. ch2:5.3 Source: topping:page-0043 \group topping-background

Under Ricci flow, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Ric =\Delta _{\mathcal L}(\Ric ), \] or, pointwise, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Ric (X,W) =\Delta \Ric (X,W)-2\langle \Ric (X),\Ric (W)\rangle +2\langle \Rm (X,\cdot ,W,\cdot ),\Ric \rangle . \]
